args.comment: Implemented mask_iban in the provided local payments/masking.py workspace: remove spaces, preserve the first two and final four characters, and replace intervening characters with '*'. Added tests/test_masking.py covering formatted and unformatted IBANs, short/empty inputs, and idempotency. Validation: python -m pytest -q — 11 passed. Changes are local; the provided workspace is not a Git checkout, so no commit or pull request was created.
